task_definition.task_description: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, get the current BTC price, and then send me a high-priority app alert with my checking account daily balance summary in USD and save that summary as a note. After that, scan for devices in the living room and set the living room light brightness to 70%, then retrieve my checking account balance sheet and publish it to me as a high-priority app update, and finally place a buy order for 500 with risk checks.
